from.headline: Earlier text agreed, record to draft. Haldane (Bank of England), "Labour’s Share", speech of 12 November 2015 (views not necessarily the Bank’s or the MPC’s): AI and smarter machines (PDF p. 14) feed the labour-share discussion, and he asks what these trends imply "for the economy and monetary policy" (p. 16), then links machine substitution to wages and the MPC’s inflation projections (p. 17). Read by the adjudicator on 2026-11-03; it meets U06 on the standard applied to Carney (AI one part of a wider technological change). Until a record is drafted and checked, Carney keeps the role in this pack. Wilkins (Bank of Canada, 18 April 2017) is later and outside the named bodies.
